# Define Workflow Content
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Define the outcome, stable knowledge, work products, and input schema for future runs. Do not populate actual run inputs.

## Interface

```text
Confirmed outcome + source needs + conventions -> define content and run shape -> workflow definition and input schemas
```

| Input | Scope | Use |
|---|---|---|
| User's outcome, users, source and output needs, confirmed destination | Only answers needed for this definition | Establish purpose and boundaries |
| `../questionnaire.md` | Outcome, Users, Inputs, References, Outputs, Review and Approval | Ask only unresolved questions |
| `../../_config/conventions.md` | Context And Sources; Names And Run Outputs | Layer and run boundary |
| Applicable `../../references/specialized-conventions.md` sections | Relevant sections only | Domain constraints |
| `_core/CONVENTIONS.md` | Repository-Specific Rules, only for a destination in this repository | Repository routing |

**Input gate:** Stop if the destination or repeated outcome is unclear. Do not invent an owner, source, approval, or output root.

**One transformation:** Specify work products and their consumers; locate authoritative stable references; define the fields a future `run-manifest.md` must hold and identify stages that will need detailed `inputs.md` records. Define observable success criteria early as a draft. Do not create populated Layer 4 material.

| Output | Location | Format | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workflow definition, source ownership, work products, draft success criteria | `<destination>/_config/workflow.md` and needed `<destination>/references/` | Markdown | Stage builder and quality builder |
| Planned input fields and validation rules | `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md`; Build Stage later creates `<destination>/stages/<stage>/references/input-schema.md` | Markdown | Stage builder |
| Definition decisions and open questions | `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md` | Markdown | Later setup operations |

**Verify:** Every product has a consumer, every source has an authoritative location, and all run values are described as schema fields rather than filled in. Stop on a missing required answer. No human approval is inferred.
